records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Ana,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the reply — glad it's going well so far.

When you're ready to put your team's real work in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up — otherwise just reply here and I'll help from there.

Best,
Chidi
